description: Brute-force login gate. Before a login proceeds the gate consults three independent delay sources, each reporting a remaining lock duration in seconds: a global source (all accounts), an optional IP-address source (only when an IP is supplied), and a per-user source. The action determines which sources are consulted: a login attempt checks global, then IP, then user; a session check (re-validating an already-logged-in user) checks only IP; recording a failed attempt first re-runs the login checks then logs the attempt. If any consulted source reports a positive delay the gate denies with a throttling error carrying which source tripped, the remaining delay, and the seconds until unlock; otherwise it permits. The first positive source in order global > ip > user determines the reported type.
